title: Asa Cleanses Judah and Builds Fortified Cities
description: King Asa does what is good in the Lord's eyes and leads a religious reform in Judah: he removes foreign altars, high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles, urging the people to seek the Lord and keep the law. During a time of peace, he builds fortified cities with walls, towers, gates, and bars, and gathers a large army from Judah and Benjamin.
